image_description: A white airship (dirigible) flying in a blue sky with scattered clouds. The airship has an elongated, cigar-shaped envelope with text on the side and a gondola suspended underneath. There are visible fins at the tail. The bottom right corner contains garbled, AI-generated text artifacts.

The red text on the side of the airship is partially legible but shows signs of distortion and inconsistent kerning/shape, suggesting imperfect text rendering.
The tail fins lack sharp edges and clear separation from the background/sky, appearing slightly soft and structurally ambiguous compared to rigid aerodynamic surfaces.
